description: Timed on-chain platform jumping game with provably fair platform layouts. Choose a route, hold to charge, release to jump to the next platform, and chase perfect center landings. Missing the platform ends the run. Pay a small GAS entry, conquer the route before the deadline, and win a fixed GAS reward: 0.1 for Meadow Hop, 0.5 for Cloud Dash, 1 for Summit Leap. Each jump sequence is verified inside the TEE enclave and every payout ranks on a global leaderboard rebuilt from chain events.
description_zh: 限时链上平台跳跃游戏，平台布局可验证公平。选择路线，按住蓄力，松开跳向下一个平台，并争取精准落在平台中央。未踩中平台则游戏结束。支付少量 GAS 报名费后，在截止时间前征服路线即可赢取固定 GAS 奖励：草地小跳 0.1、云端冲刺 0.5、山巅飞跃 1。每次跳跃序列都在 TEE 飞地内验证，每笔奖励都会进入由链上事件重建的全网积分榜。
name: Jump Rush

operations.description: Pay the entry fee and the Morpheus enclave generates a deterministic platform layout. Meadow 0.02 GAS entry wins 0.1; Cloud 0.10 wins 0.5; Summit 0.20 wins 1.
operations.name: Start Run

operations.description: Pull your accumulated GAS winnings and any unused entry credit back to your wallet.
operations.name: Withdraw Winnings

operation_panel.subtitle: Hold to charge, release to jump. Conquer the selected route before the deadline to win GAS.
operation_panel.title: Jump Rush

aa.description: Direct OneGate and NeoLine signing flow is used for the initial release.

oracle.description: The game opens a Morpheus runtime session to generate hidden platform layouts and verify the recorded jump sequence before settlement. No callback is required; the contract verifies the TEE signer directly on-chain.

tee.description: Morpheus TEE signs the hidden puzzle commitment and final settlement digest; the contract verifies the enclave signer directly without a Morpheus oracle callback.
